body.text:
Meet Jacky, the swaddle transition jacket.
It’s designed for the stage when your baby is ready to move out of the swaddle, but still needs calming support for the startle reflex.

text_fields.title: Lose the swaddle, not the sleep
text_fields.caption: takingcarababies.com
text_fields.link_description: Safe for babies who are rolling or starting to roll, Jacky is a non-weighted swaddle transition jacket designed to support smoother sleep through the transition.
